summary: Stopping or retiring a headless root now stops every exec and PTY task it declared, and the root settles only after they end

replay.detail: No replay or projection changes; the reconciler reads the existing declarations and their st3.agent tags.

schema.detail: No database, claim kind or schema change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; members may upgrade in any order.

compatibility.detail: Behaviour change: a stopped or retired root now also stops its tasks, so a task can no longer outlive a stop of its root. Each member stops the tasks it hosts; an older member keeps leaving them running.

downtime.detail: A daemon restart to install the build; tasks of an already stopped root end on the first pass after it.

manual.detail: Nothing to configure. Starting the root again declares its tasks again.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary freely; nothing is persisted.
